meta.title: Global Todos
meta.description: Cross-session todos for DeepSeek Harness. One JSON file you own; a person and an agent write the same records. Every item keeps when it was added, a description, attached documents and links, an optional plan of steps, and the sentence it came from. Hand it to a conversation in one click - the steps travel as a numbered plan - then read back what that conversation last said. An agent's "done" stays a claim until you confirm it.
